newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ROZENTAL LIKELY TO BE OUT FOR REST OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROZENTAL LIKELY TO BE OUT FOR REST OF SEASON.

text.p: Chilean international Sebastian Rozental, who has played just 58 minutes for Glasgow Rangers since his 4.0 million pounds ($6.6 million) move from Universidad Catolica two months ago, is likely to miss the rest of this season, the Glasgow Herald reported on Wednesday.
Rozental, 20, broke down on his return to full training on Tuesday and underwent exploratory surgery on Tuesday night.

He played just 13 minutes as a substitute against Motherwell on January 18 and a week later played in the first half against St Johnstone in a Scottish Cup match, scoring a goal but coming off at halftime after picking up the injury early in the game.

The news was the second quick blow to Rangers manager Walter Smith who said on Wednesday that English midfielder Paul Gascoigne is liklely to miss the Old Firm clash against Celtic on March 16 because his injured ankle has to remain in plaster for at least another week.
